originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire wreath XZ AABB

compiledWorldPlacement.limits: one fixed authored standalone wreath pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;20 finite sole/floor ray pairs on four flat contact pads,63 finite walkability samples and conservative current road, original-card, meadow, shore and building-proxy envelope clearances. These finite witnesses do not verify full pad contact, support stability, load, physical behavior, body fit, whole-world placement or all-camera visibility

compiledWorldScope: Existing current Scene after synchronous construction/tree-road correction. Node has no DOM or original-art decode; native originalArt-ready Scene and visual checks remain separate.
